about: Customers who chose whether to join a loyalty program. Past spend and age were measured before joining; spend in the next 90 days and renewal after.
review: Goals and labels drafted by Claude on 2026-11-14, paraphrases written by Claude. Labels reviewed by Ben on 2026-11-18.

goals.goal: Do loyalty members spend more in the next 90 days?
paraphrases: Is 90-day spend higher for program members?
members vs non-members, spend over the next three months
Do people in the loyalty program buy more afterwards?
do loyalty memebers spend more next quarter

labels.why: Spend after joining, members against non-members.

paraphrases: Are members more likely to renew?
renewal rate, members vs non-members
Does the program improve renewals?
do ppl who join renew more

labels.why: People chose to join, and joiners already spent more, so the effect of joining needs members compared with similar non-members (Ben, 2026-11-18). A plain members-vs-others difference gets no credit.

goals.goal: Is the loyalty program worth it?
goals.note: Worth it needs the program's cost, which isn't in the table (Ben, 2026-11-18).
paraphrases: Does the loyalty program pay off?
Should we keep running the program?
is loyalty worth the cost
Is the program a good investment?

goals.goal: Are members more likely to stick around?
paraphrases: Do members churn less?
member retention vs non-member retention
Is the program keeping customers longer?
do members stay with us more

labels.why: Renewal is the only measure of staying.

goals.goal: Do customers in the East renew less than customers in the West?
paraphrases: Is renewal lower in the East region than the West?
East vs West renewal rate
Are Western customers more likely to renew than Eastern ones?
east region renews less then west?

labels.why: Renewal by region, the two named.

goals.goal: Do mobile customers spend less than desktop customers?
paraphrases: Is spend lower for people who shop on phones?
spend by device
Do desktop shoppers spend more?
mobile customers spend less?

labels.why: Spend by device, using the most recent spend.

goals.goal: After joining, do customers buy more?
paraphrases: Once people join, do they spend more?
post-join spend for members vs others
Does becoming a member increase purchases?
do customers buy more after they sign up for loyalty

labels.why: People chose to join, and joiners already spent more, so the effect of joining needs members compared with similar non-members (Ben, 2026-11-18). A plain members-vs-others difference gets no credit.

goals.goal: Were people who joined already big spenders before?
paraphrases: Did members spend more than non-members even before joining?
past spend, members vs non-members
Do the people who join already spend a lot?
were joiners high spenders to begin with

labels.why: Spend before joining, by membership. Fine as a description of who joins, though not as an effect.

goals.goal: What happens to next-quarter revenue when someone joins?
paraphrases: How does joining change revenue over the following quarter?
member revenue in the next 90 days
Does the program lift short-term revenue?
next quarter revenu for people who join vs dont

labels.why: People chose to join, and joiners already spent more, so the effect of joining needs members compared with similar non-members (Ben, 2026-11-18). A plain members-vs-others difference gets no credit.

goals.goal: Did spending go up after we launched the program in March?
paraphrases: Since the program launched, are customers spending more?
spend before vs after the program started
Did revenue rise after the loyalty launch?
spending since launch, up or down
Do members have higher NPS?
Are members happier with us?
member satisfaction vs non-members
do members like us more
